notes: Sizes are normalized from viewport units to their px value at the 1440px capture width, then expressed in rem: body 4.513888vw = 65px = 4.0625rem; index gutter 1.805555vw = 26px = 1.625rem. The site itself hard-codes vw everywhere and has no rem/px type scale at all — reuse via clamp() with a rem middle term, not raw vw. Leading is a RATIO of line-height to font-size and is deliberately sub-1 (56/65 = 0.86 desktop; mobile 7.4667vw/7.7333vw = 0.97). Only two type sizes exist in the entire stylesheet. Spacing is likewise vw-derived (0.208333/0.416666/0.694444/0.972222/1.776666vw) and rounded here to their 1440px px values; there is no 8px grid. color.dark is OMITTED: the raw profile reports theme.supportsDark=true, but the page has exactly one theme (black ground, no toggle, no prefers-color-scheme rules) — that flag is an artifact of the ground already being #000. surface and bg are the same value because the site has no surfaces, cards, or fills at all — the only non-black backgrounds are the yellow CTA square and the cursor chip. muted equals fg for the same reason: there is no secondary text color, only a hover color. motion.durations lists the single observed value (50s) — real per-row durations are computed as overflow_chars x step_ms; the raw profile's easings 'ease' and 'steps(50)' confirm the step count equals the character overflow. Both entries the profiler filed under motion.scroll_effects were rejected as effects: one is the position:fixed header (a pin) and the other is a marquee transform misread as parallax — only the pin is recorded above. rafCalls=0, IntersectionObservers=0, libraries=[], keyframeCount=1 — this page does not animate on scroll. prmRules=0 against a 50s infinite animation, hence reduced_motion: not-respected. focus-outline is recorded as an anti-token: #101010 on #000000 is 1.1:1 and effectively invisible.
